Description.Name: Raquel Martinez
Description.Details: Raquel Martines, known as "Bandit", is a 28-year-old MechWarrior, whose skills on the battlefield are as captivating as they are deadly. With a heritage steeped in MechWarrior tradition, she emerges as a testament to the martial legacy of her family. The callsign "Bandit" comes from her combat style, often opting for the more risky move in order to get her enemy right where she wants them.
